statuses.confirmed: reproduced with source trace and independent challenge
statuses.mitigated: root cause repaired with stated evidence scope

findings.title: Capture inherited ambient proxy routing
findings.attacker: Inherited process environment controlled by launcher or upstream job
findings.prerequisites: Graph capture supplied a token and no explicit operator proxy policy
findings.invariant: Credential destination must use explicit approved routing
findings.impact: Reproduction observed inherited proxy selection. Credential interception was not executed and additionally depends on proxy/TLS trust.
findings.repair: Explicit ProxyHandler({}) plus no-redirect handler; independent regression verifies routing policy
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: MCP paths lacked operator filesystem capability
findings.attacker: Compromised or manipulated model controlling tool arguments
findings.prerequisites: MCP server running with host-readable files; no filesystem authority configured
findings.invariant: Model may select actions only within operator-created read/write scope
findings.impact: Pre-fix call reached a path without an authority object. Post-fix hostile read/write requests rejected before dispatch. No real credential was read.
findings.repair: Mandatory FilesystemAuthority passed only by operator; default deny; request metadata/environment cannot promote authority
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Sibling operation lock escaped granted output root
findings.attacker: Model selecting a permitted output directory
findings.prerequisites: Output itself equals write root; local generation creates a lock in its parent
findings.invariant: All effects including lock files must stay in write capability
findings.impact: Pre-fix authority accepted request whose sibling lock was outside capability; regression now rejects before output mutation.
findings.repair: Require output.parent in write scope as well as output
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Synthetic recovery accepted self-pinned replacement executable
findings.attacker: Contributor controlling imported or resumed executor directory
findings.prerequisites: SyntheticExecutor constructed from attacker-controlled persisted artifact; manifest and tool both replaceable
findings.invariant: Executable identity must be anchored outside mutable evidence
findings.impact: Pre-fix constructor accepted substitute tool when its manifest hash matched. Arbitrary malicious tool execution was not performed.
findings.repair: Compare against independently running interpreter digest; actual process uses verified open descriptor
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Persisted output-only configuration could carry template expressions
findings.attacker: Writer controlling native fixture configuration and manifest
findings.prerequisites: Configuration value admitted as Terraform JSON string
findings.invariant: Output-only constants must not activate Terraform evaluation
findings.impact: Source trace reaches Terraform expression parsing. Initial construction already guarded during review; persisted configuration variant hardened before dynamic exfiltration test.
findings.repair: _validate invokes bounded recursive _json_snapshot on persisted configuration; full pre-fix native impact not claimed
findings.blocker: No pre-fix native file-disclosure proof; post-fix constructor regression confirms persisted-expression rejection.
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Readback ignored changed lineage with equal desired output
findings.attacker: Concurrent local state writer or faulty executor
findings.prerequisites: State can change after dispatch without changing desired output value
findings.input: Different state lineage/serial with same output digest
findings.invariant: Success and reconciliation must preserve state identity
findings.impact: Fault-injected replacement state had desired output but changed lineage; pre-fix execution reported succeeded_verified. Owner red/green and independent local recovery classifier now detect lineage/serial divergence.
findings.repair: Bind before lineage and serial; require unchanged lineage and permitted serial transition in execution, receipt parsing and reconciliation.
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Directory enumeration lacks early bounds
findings.attacker: Writer populating resumed local evidence directory
findings.prerequisites: Ability to create many nested entries within selected evidence root
findings.input: Large work tree or journal directory
findings.invariant: Resource bounds apply before sorting or recursive materialization
findings.impact: Source availability-hardening candidate; no resource exhaustion performed. Independent counting iterator verifies journal parser consumes at most six entries before refusal.
findings.repair: Work and nested state metadata enumeration have fixed early entry/name/type limits; journal consumes at most six entries before sorting.
findings.blocker: No denial-of-service exploit or high-severity impact claimed
findings.reviewer: independent security subagent; implementation by separate owner; shared filesystem/context is not organizational AppSec

findings.title: Native Atmos staging included unadmitted unrelated YAML
findings.input: Unselected included stack with dynamic tag or escaping import
findings.invariant: Every source copied for native processing must pass inert admission
findings.trace: native_atmos._snapshot -> selected-stack resolve -> stages all stack sources
findings.impact: Mocked supervisor demonstrated unadmitted dynamic YAML reached staging; no hook or command execution proved.
findings.repair: Admit all discovered config/stack YAML source before staging or native dispatch; selected resolution still uses independent comparator.

findings.title: Self-rehashed saved plan could differ from approved JSON review
findings.input: Substituted saved plan with attacker-updated bindings/preparation and benign sidecar
findings.invariant: Bound plan contents must match displayed review and independently authorized desired configuration before dispatch
findings.impact: Independent pre-fix synthetic replay changed local state to unreviewed value before readback rejected it. Native dangerous-resource variant was inferred/source-tested; independent native check used harmless output-only substitution.
findings.repair: Validate synthetic plan value/before-state against bindings. Native pin executes show on exact saved binary; compare raw sidecar hash then strict independent output-only desired/config semantics. Recompute review summary before minting grant and dispatch.

findings.title: Byte-identical no-op could obtain a fresh grant in another receipt directory
findings.input: Consumed local request replayed with second journal root
findings.invariant: Approval consumption must persist at target independently of chosen journal location
findings.impact: Owner reproduced a no-op state permitting another approval after success; explicit durable target-local consumption now rejects it.
findings.repair: Create durable consumed.json before dispatch and reject approval/execution when it exists.
